scientific_scope_status: With bounded strain and common white Gaussian stress noise, a permanent spring and arbitrarily slow passive Maxwell alternatives become indistinguishable on every finite horizon while equilibrium modulus differs. Without a rate floor the fixed-horizon uniform minimax squared error is A²/4. Even unbounded random stopping cannot uniformly certify permanence at finite time more often than its allowed false-solid probability. A conventional one-sided mixture confidence sequence under a step does give upper bounds on g converging pointwise, eventually certifying any positive tolerance gamma>g on the coverage event without a uniform duration.
